notes:
## Fixed

- Keep large, full-height windows above the taskbar when they extend partly beyond the left or right display edge, including the reported ChatGPT layout. Preserve their top, left and width.
- Respect the existing menu-bar inset on secondary displays even when macOS reports the full display as the visible frame.
- Recover interrupted height adjustments after Accessibility geometry reads or immediate rollback fail, as observed in the reported Discord case. Retain the original frame and use the existing guarded restoration queue.
- Prevent delayed recovery from overwriting a newer adjustment. Preserve manual moves and resizing, process identity checks, cancellation and bounded retry behavior.

## Verification

Eleven new regressions cover measured geometry, animated and instant writes, failed reads before and after acknowledgement, delayed recovery, manual geometry, process reuse and workspace-event isolation. CI verifies the full unit suite, a separate constrained Swift-executor run, WindowLab replay, tooling, localization, deployment compatibility and the Apple Silicon application package.

The original ChatGPT and Discord states were captured read-only. Automated production-controller tests reproduce the failures; native acceptance of the new binary remains a separate check.

No new settings, permissions or runtime dependencies are introduced.
